territorial_scope.description: Applies to activities on roads and zones designated within the administrative area of Pudong New Area.

evidence.quote: 本规定适用于在浦东新区行政区域内划定的路段、区域开展

summary.short: Governs driverless intelligent connected vehicles on designated Pudong New Area roads and zones, covering testing, demonstration and commercial operation. Requires enterprises to obtain safety self-declaration confirmation, plates and operating certificates, imposes data, cybersecurity and insurance duties, and allows suspension or termination of activities. In force from 1 February 2023.
summary.long: The regulation governs driverless intelligent connected vehicles, meaning vehicles with no driver or test safety operator aboard, in testing, demonstration, and commercial operation on designated roads and zones in Pudong New Area (Art. 2). Activities follow graded management by scenario risk (Art. 3). Enterprises must be independent legal persons with technical capability, remote monitoring, emergency takeover staff and insurance (Art. 6). Vehicles must meet minimal-risk operation and safety requirements and prior test-mileage conditions (Arts. 7-9). Authorities confirm enterprises' safety self-declarations, with third-party organisations and experts, before plates and identification signs are issued (Arts. 10, 12). Commercial operation requires road transport qualifications and operating certificates; fees follow government or market pricing rules (Arts. 15-16). Enterprises must install monitoring devices, upload data, report software or hardware changes, keep fault and accident records and meet data security rules (Arts. 17, 21, 24-27). Enterprises first compensate victims of accidents for which the vehicle side is liable, with recourse against responsible parties (Art. 29). Authorities may suspend (Art. 31) or terminate (Art. 32) activities.

entities.name: 浦东新区科技经济部门
entities.function: Receives enterprises' safety self-declarations and supporting documents and notifies confirmation decisions in writing (Art. 10 para 2); with Lingang administration, confirms self-declarations for road test, demonstration and operation stages (Art. 10 para 1); daily supervision and back-end monitoring (Art. 17 para 1); may suspend or terminate activities (Arts. 31-32).

evidence.quote: 浦东新区科技经济部门、临港新片区管委会负责收取企业提交的安全性自我声明和相关证明材料

entities.function: Establishes the work mechanism and support measures for the innovation applications in its area (Art. 4 para 4); performs the same confirmation, receipt, supervision and suspension or termination functions as the Pudong science and economy department (Arts. 10, 17, 31, 32).

evidence.quote: 中国（上海）自由贸易试验区临港新片区管理委员会（以下简称临港新片区管委会）应当建立促进智能网联汽车创新应用的工作机制

entities.name: 公安机关交通管理部门
entities.function: Registers vehicles that have obtained product access or equivalent recognition (Art. 16 para 1); issues vehicle plates and temporary plates and identification markers (Arts. 5, 12); handles traffic violations by vehicle owners or managers (Art. 28); determines traffic accident liability (Art. 29 para 1).

evidence.quote: 可以向公安机关交通管理部门申领车辆号牌

entities.name: 浦东新区建设交通部门
entities.function: Receives applications from enterprises for vehicle operating certificates for demonstration operation (Art. 15 para 2); also carries out coordinated infrastructure planning for vehicle-road coordination (Art. 19 para 1).

evidence.quote: 向浦东新区建设交通部门或者临港新片区管委会申请办理相关车辆营运证件

entities.name: 市经济信息化、交通、公安等部门
entities.function: Organise, with Pudong and Lingang bodies, the confirmation of safety self-declarations at each stage, together with third-party institutions and experts (Art. 10 para 1); coordinate and guide cross-district matters (Art. 10 para 3); the city-level bodies form a work mechanism for testing and application (Art. 4 para 2).

evidence.quote: 由市经济信息化、交通、公安等部门和浦东新区科技经济部门、临港新片区管委会按照各自职责，组织有关部门、第三方机构和专家，对相应阶段的安全性自我声明进行确认

entities.name: 公安机关
entities.function: Imposes on-site temporary control in specified circumstances, and gives instructions that the enterprise must follow immediately (Art. 23 para 2).

evidence.quote: 公安机关依法实施现场临时管制时，企业应当按照公安机关的指令，立即采取避让、暂停运行、终止运行等处置措施

notes: Adopted by the Shanghai Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee on 2022-11-23; effective 2023-02-01 (Art. 34). Only one entity category is named: public bodies. Firms are addressed generically as 企业 and are not coded as named entities. Third-party institutions (Arts. 10-11) are unnamed. No external instrument is named; general references such as 有关法律、行政法规 (Art. 1) and 道路交通安全法律、法规 (Arts. 22, 28, 29) are not identified by title or number. Several qualifying values are referred to but not set in this text: 规定里程或者时间, 规定值 (人工接管率), and 规定 (Arts. 7-9, 11); the text does not state them. Art. 33 delegates detailed rules for unmanned delivery and cleaning equipment to Pudong and Lingang bodies.

definitions.term: 无驾驶人智能网联汽车

evidence.quote: 本规定所称的无驾驶人智能网联汽车，是指车内不配备驾驶人和测试安全员的智能网联汽车。
前款所称的路段、区域，是指用于社会机动车辆通行的路段、区域。

obligations.summary: Municipal government to establish a coordination mechanism and policy measures for the intelligent connected vehicle industry and optimise the innovation environment.

evidence.quote: 市人民政府应当建立完善促进智能网联汽车产业发展的工作协调机制和政策措施

obligations.summary: Enterprises conducting road testing, demonstration application or demonstration operation must apply for confirmation of a safety self-declaration; the vehicle may then obtain plates and, for road transport demonstration operation, approval by the transport department is required.

evidence.quote: 开展无驾驶人智能网联汽车道路测试、示范应用、示范运营的企业应当申请安全性自我声明的确认

obligations.summary: Applicant enterprises must be independent legal persons with technical capability and suitable vehicles, must provide a remote monitoring system and trained emergency takeover personnel, and must have insured or undertaken to insure compulsory motor vehicle liability and commercial insurance.

evidence.quote: 申请安全性自我声明确认的企业应当符合以下要求

obligations.summary: Vehicles applying for road testing must have a minimum risk operation mode, meet functional and information safety standards, carry driverless-state display and warning devices and night reflectors, and complete prior testing with a manual takeover rate within the prescribed value; high-risk tests require prior low-risk testing without serious incidents.

evidence.quote: 申请安全性自我声明确认的车辆应当符合以下要求

obligations.summary: Vehicles applying for crewed or crewed-cargo demonstration application must complete prescribed road testing, with no traffic violations or vehicle-caused accidents and a manual takeover rate within the prescribed value.

evidence.quote: 申请安全性自我声明确认的车辆应当经过规定里程或者时间的道路测试

obligations.summary: Vehicles applying for crewed, cargo or specific-scenario demonstration operation must meet technical, dimensional, axle load, mass and safety standards and complete prescribed demonstration application with no violations and a manual takeover rate within the prescribed value.

evidence.quote: 申请安全性自我声明确认的车辆应当符合以下要求

obligations.summary: Listed municipal and Pudong departments and the Lingang管委会 organise confirmation of each stage's safety self-declaration with other departments, third-party bodies and experts; the Pudong science and economy department collects declarations and notifies decisions to enterprises in writing.

evidence.quote: 对相应阶段的安全性自我声明进行确认

obligations.summary: Competent authorities must organise third-party consistency spot checks on batch applications for same-stage same-model vehicles and decide on the basis of the results.

evidence.quote: 有关主管部门应当组织第三方机构进行一致性抽查

obligations.summary: Vehicles on road testing may not carry persons unrelated to the testing activity or cargo other than counterweights.

evidence.quote: 但不得搭载与测试活动无关的人员和用于配重以外的货物

obligations.summary: When carrying persons or goods in demonstration application, enterprises must disclose possible risks to service recipients and take necessary safety measures.

evidence.quote: 应当向服务对象明示可能存在的风险

obligations.summary: Carried persons or goods may not exceed the vehicle's rated occupancy or rated load, and dangerous goods may not be carried.

evidence.quote: 不得超出车辆的额定乘员和核定载质量，不得搭载危险货物

obligations.summary: Demonstration operation enterprises must hold or cooperate with a road transport operating qualification, use inspected vehicles, specify a fixed operating area and hours, and maintain a sound safety management system.

evidence.quote: 具备相应的道路运输经营资质或者条件

obligations.summary: Fee standards must be stated in the operation plan, and fee standards for charges to unspecified persons must be publicly disclosed.

evidence.quote: 面向不特定对象收费的，收费标准应当向社会公示

obligations.summary: Enterprises using registered driverless vehicles for commercial operation must obtain a road transport operating qualification, and vehicles must suit the business, pass inspection and hold operating certificates.

evidence.quote: 利用符合前款要求的无驾驶人智能网联汽车从事商业化运营的企业，应当取得道路运输经营资质

obligations.summary: Pudong science and economy department and Lingang管委会 must strengthen day-to-day supervision of driverless vehicle operation and back-end monitoring.

evidence.quote: 加强对无驾驶人智能网联汽车运行的日常监督管理

obligations.summary: Enterprises must install monitoring devices, connect data to the designated data platform with real-time upload to the municipal platform, and periodically submit innovation application reports to the district or Lingang authority.

obligations.summary: Driverless vehicles on public roads must bear a conspicuous marking and place or affix the temporary driving plate and vehicle identification sign as required, and comply with traffic rules.

evidence.quote: 建立网络安全管理制度，落实网络安全等级保护制度

obligations.summary: Enterprises must establish full-process data security and personal information protection management systems and assume responsibility for them.

evidence.quote: 建立健全全流程数据安全和个人信息保护管理制度

evidence.quote: 按照规定及时告知用户并向有关主管部门报告
